```{r}
stadium_data <- read_csv("../../data/ballparks_stadium_data_2022.csv")

stadium_data |>
  head()

stadium_data |>
  ggplot(aes(y = hr_park_effects,  x = team_name, fill = team_name)) +
  geom_col()

stadium_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = extra_distance, y = hr_park_effects, color = ballpark)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Extra Distance vs HR Park Effects by Ballpark",
    x = "Extra Distance (yards)",
    y = "HR Park Effects (100 = league avg)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


```

```{r}
`2022HitterStats` <- read_csv("../../data/2022HitterStats.csv")
head(`2022HitterStats`) 

```
```{r}
Player_team_info <- mlb_stats(stat_type = 'season', stat_group = 'hitting', season = 2022) |>
  select(player_id, team_name)
head(Player_team_info)


Full_22_Hitter_stats <- `2022HitterStats` |>
  left_join(Player_team_info, join_by(player_id))
head(Full_22_Hitter_stats)




```
